$comment: Canonical MCP roster. build.mjs renders this into .mcp.json (Claude Code), the mcp block of opencode.json, and .cursor/mcp.json. Edit here only. profile 'default' ships in every generated config; 'opt-in' ships only with `node build.mjs --with <name>`.

github.why: /cr-run files issues and /cr-fix opens PRs. This server's OAuth does not support dynamic client registration, so the in-agent OAuth flow fails; a token in the Authorization header is the working path. Toolsets are filtered by the X-MCP-Toolsets header (44 tools -> 38) - the ?toolsets= query param is silently ignored.

context7.why: Version-accurate library docs. Cuts hallucinated APIs in /cr-fix on unfamiliar dependencies. Two tools, ~400 tokens, no auth - the cheapest server here.

playwright.why: Drives a real browser so /verify can check a web UI actually renders. ~21 tools (~5k tokens); worth it on repos with a front end.

sentry.why: Turns /cr-run severity from a guess into evidence ('this path throws 400x/day in prod'). Only useful on a repo wired to Sentry, so it stays opt-in: enable with `node build.mjs --with sentry`.
